spans.s: Dust, an atom of dust, sand &c.; तुरगखुरहतस्तथा हि रेणुः Ś.1.32.
A particular measure.-Comp. -उत्पातः rising of dust. -गर्भः an hour-glass.-पदवी a path of dust. -रूषित a. soiled with dust. (-तः) an ass. -वासः a bee. -सारः, -सारकः camphor.
रेणुकः [rēṇukḥ], A particular mantra (formula) recited over weapons; Rām.
रेणुका [rēṇukā], 1 The wife of Jamadagni and mother of Paraśurāma; see जमदग्नि.
A kind of medicinal substance. -Comp. -तनयः, -सुतः an epithet of Paraśurāma.
